correctness.rationale: Every row-invariant simplex is encoded by pairs of reflected top/bottom horizontal edges and fixed middle horizontal edges; reflected vertical edges share a midpoint and cannot occur. The simplex orientation sign and reduced empty face give reduced Lefschetz = minus the signed face-orbit sum. The exact 7-state column-by-column existence automaton counts each extendible orbit-face once; its weighted transition matrix A and terminal vector b satisfy A^6 b=b with initial evaluations 0,-1,1. Thus the periodic formula holds for every n. A separate complete tiling-based reconstruction verifies n=1..8. The 2026 sphere-wedge theorem supplies degree and rank, and rational averaging proves quotient eigenspace ranks.
